ClinicalDocument.title: SYNTHETIC RECORD, NOT A REAL MEDICAL RECORD — Progress Note 5 — Preventive Visit — Joe Frazier

code.displayName: Periodic reevaluation and management of healthy individual

text.paragraph: Mr. Frazier is a 64-year-old former professional heavyweight boxer who runs a boxing gym, with type 2 diabetes, hypertension, hyperlipidemia, obesity, and compensated cirrhosis from MASLD found this spring, who comes for his yearly preventive visit eight weeks after his three-month review. He takes semaglutide 1 mg weekly, metformin, lisinopril, amlodipine 10 mg and atorvastatin without missed doses. His home blood pressure readings average 126/78. He has lost 5.4 kg since intake and has had no alcohol since the liver results. He had the dilated eye examination three weeks ago after missing the first appointment. He asked again whether the blows he took in the ring will affect his memory; today's cognitive screen was done for that reason. He has no new symptoms. [S]

Follow-up: Seven-month review in nine weeks with the surveillance ultrasound and AFP, A1c, kidney tests, the second zoster dose and the autumn vaccines. PSA result by phone. Colonoscopy to be scheduled. Next preventive visit in one year. Next scheduled visit 2026-09-14: seven-month review: six-month liver cancer surveillance ultrasound and AFP, A1c, kidney function, urine albumin and vaccines. [S]

Voluntary advance care planning discussion of about 18 minutes, with his consent. He named a health care agent, and a health care proxy form was completed; the agent is recorded in the chart and is not named here. He said that what matters most to him is staying independent and keeping his gym open for the young fighters. He chose not to record specific treatment preferences today and would like to talk again after his next liver checks. The plan will be revisited yearly or after any serious illness. [S]
